caption: The drawing depicts a lidded urn with a classical form, rendered in grayscale with fine pencil shading. The urn features a rounded body on a narrow stem, which flares into a square beaded base. It has a high domed lid topped with an urn-shaped finial. Decorative garlands of leaves drape around the urn's body, with a central oval medallion containing ornate monogrammed script. To the right, a circular plan view presents the top of the lid, showing concentric decorative leaf patterns. Below this, a detailed drawing of a leaf sprig appears, matching the garland design on the vessel. In the lower right corner, a small scale diagram of the urn includes annotated dimensions. All elements sit within a double-ruled rectangular border. The image is monochromatic, and the composition arranges all views and details neatly around the central elevation of the urn.
title: Silver Sugar Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
